Is a capacity-evidence bundle strong enough to resolve absolute adequacy?

Source: R/capacity_evidence.R
capacity_evidence_sufficient.Rd

The evidence is sufficient only when BOTH conditions hold: the access fit is identified (a wait-based adequacy exists and was not refused), and the all-payer demand basis behind it is fully identified (no age band was dropped).

Usage

capacity_evidence_sufficient(bundle)

Arguments

bundle

A `capacity_evidence_bundle`.

Value

A list with `sufficient` (logical) and `reasons` (character vector of the failing conditions; empty when sufficient).

See also

[resolve_adequacy_gated()]

Other capacity-evidence: capacity_evidence_bundle(), chia_calibrated_all_payer_total(), project_absolute_adequacy(), resolve_adequacy_gated(), validate_capacity_evidence()

Examples

capacity_evidence_sufficient(
  capacity_evidence_bundle(data.frame(identified = TRUE, adequacy = 1.3),
                           list(fully_identified = TRUE, total = 900)))
#> $sufficient
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $reasons
#> character(0)
#>
